meta.title: Signs at the Zoo
meta.textType: functional: a set of zoo signs inside a short frame story

paragraphs: Mia and her dad are at the zoo. A sign is on the door. It says: "NO DOGS." "Sorry, Pip!" says Mia. Pip is at home. "What does this sign say, Mia?" asks Dad. "I can read it!" says Mia.

One sign says: "TIGERS AND BEARS." Mia and Dad look at the big tigers. Then Mia sees a sign next to the bears. It says: "PLEASE DON'T GIVE FOOD TO THE ANIMALS." "Can we give food to the bears?" asks Dad. "No, Dad! Read the sign!" says Mia. Look! A sign says: "SNAKES, LIZARDS AND SPIDERS." Dad sees a sign by the water. It says: "CROCODILES! DON'T SWIM HERE!" Mia and Dad smile.

"Count the hippos, Mia," says Dad. "What is the number?" "Three!" says Mia. A sign is next to the giraffes. It says: "FOOD AND DRINK." Mia and Dad eat ice cream there. "Thank you, Dad!" says Mia. Mia loves the zoo. She can read the signs!
text.summary: Mia and her dad visit the zoo. Mia reads the signs, and Dad asks her what they say.
